from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full-length uniform lines are the dividers between the small panels.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_edges = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_edges = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_spans = [(row_edges[i] + 1, row_edges[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_edges) - 1) if row_edges[i + 1] > row_edges[i] + 1]
    col_spans = [(col_edges[i] + 1, col_edges[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_edges) - 1) if col_edges[i + 1] > col_edges[i] + 1]
    # Most common non-divider color is the panel background; rare dots encode a count.
    divider_colors = {grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols}
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in divider_colors)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in row_spans:
        outrow = []
        for c0, c1 in col_spans:
            tile = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
            dots = sum(v != background for v in tile)
            outrow.append(1 if dots == 2 else background)
        out.append(outrow)
    return out
